# Individual-agent evaluation contract

Bind every plan and run to target ID/version/hash, environment, baseline,
datasets, split policy, graders, authority, budgets, acceptance criteria and raw
artifacts. A changed candidate, prompt, model, tool, fixture, grader or host may
invalidate comparability.

Protect holdout answers from architects, doctors and optimizers. Independence
is an information-flow and decision-right property, not merely another model.

Documentation cases verify exact root containment, artifact owners/consumers,
decision authority, freshness, provenance, links, generated-file protection and
docs-to-code/code-to-docs consistency.

Use deterministic assertions first, reproducible outcomes second, calibrated
rubrics third, proxies fourth and explicit expert uncertainty last. Preserve raw
evidence and disagreements.
